{
  "claims": [
    {"field": "context.accounts_on_address_30d", "value": 3, "statement": "The shipping address has activity from three accounts in the specified window.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.ship_to_home", "value": 1, "statement": "The shipping address is the account's home address.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.home_address_age_days", "value": 0.0010416666666666667, "statement": "The home address was registered only recently.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.account_age_days", "value": 0.0010416666666666667, "statement": "The account was opened only recently.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.accounts_on_device_30d", "value": 1, "statement": "Only this account has activity on the device in the specified window.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.email_root_other_accounts", "value": 0, "statement": "No other account has a matching normalized email.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.promo_uses_linked_accounts", "value": 1, "statement": "Only this account among the specified linked accounts used the same promotion.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.unauthorized_disputes_lost_user", "value": 0, "statement": "No earlier unauthorized-use dispute was resolved against the platform.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.never_pay_determined_user", "value": 0, "statement": "No earlier never-pay determination is recorded.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.inr_claims_rejected_user", "value": 0, "statement": "No earlier item-not-received claim was resolved against the account on a delivered order.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "decision.checks[0].check", "value": "id_check", "statement": "The completed verification was an identity and issuer-authentication check.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "decision.checks[0].outcome", "value": "passed", "statement": "The identity and issuer-authentication check passed.", "derived": null},
    {"field": "context.shipped_at_decision", "value": 0, "statement": "The order had not shipped at decision time.", "derived": null}
  ],
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation": "household",
      "likelihood": "high",
      "reasoning": "A genuine household can share a shipping address while its members open separate accounts. Successful identity and issuer authentication favors this explanation, although the recently registered home address does not qualify for the household exception."
    },
    {
      "explanation": "synthetic_identity",
      "likelihood": "low",
      "reasoning": "The shared shipping address could suggest coordinated identities, but there is no matching normalized email or shared-device account cluster. Passed identity and issuer authentication further weakens this explanation."
    }
  ],
  "disposition": "clear",
  "citations": [
    "R08",
    "FP-2 §6.4(b)",
    "FP-2 §6.3",
    "FP-2 §6.6(b)",
    "FP-2 §5.2",
    "FP-2 §5.3(a)"
  ],
  "next_check": "none",
  "memo": "R08 holds and Linkage is the only adverse family. Shipping to the home address does not remove R08 because the home registration is too recent for the household exception. No earlier outcome settles this order. Under §6.6(b), Linkage required id_check; that check passed, completing all required verification. Section 5.3(a) therefore requires clear and prohibits further adverse dispositions. A legitimate shared household is more plausible than coordinated identity misuse given successful verification. No further check is needed."
}
